<!--
No fixed sections. Use headings that fit this change — the merged pull requests
are the guide, and the ones worth copying name their own structure ("The
evidence", "Why removing it loses nothing", "What this cannot do, and what
would") instead of filling a skeleton.

Whatever the shape, a reader should come away knowing what the change does,
what it deliberately leaves out, and how you know it works. The last is not "CI
is green" — it is the measurement, the limit, or the break you made to confirm
a new test can fail at all.

The squash commit takes the COMMIT messages, not this description, so the two
are written for different readers and neither has to serve both.

The commit convention, changesets and the Eclipse Contributor Agreement are in
CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->
